assertions: Explicitly refutes the authenticity of the saying, classifying it as Mawdu' (Fabricated) or severely Da'if.
Names recognized classical or contemporary muhaddithin who graded the narration (e.g. Ibn al-Jawzi, al-Albani).
Contrasts the fabricated text with an authentic Hadith on seeking knowledge (e.g. Sunan Ibn Majah 224: 'Seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim').
